name: Purdue University Northwest
academic_ranking: Purdue University Northwest is a 4-year public university (part of the Purdue University system) located in Hammond, Indiana. Total enrollment approx. 9,051 with about 8,201 undergraduates; student-to-faculty ratio approx. 17:1. Suburban campus setting with on-campus housing available.
financial_aid: As a public regional university, PNW offers in-state (Indiana resident) and out-of-state tuition rates. Federal and state need-based aid, merit scholarships, and athletic aid are available. Exact current tuition figures were not confirmed from a live authoritative source during this research (2026-07); prospective recruits should confirm current rates with the PNW Bursar/Financial Aid office.
facilities_notes: PNW softball competes at the NCAA Division II level in the GLIAC. Specific softball facility (field/stadium) details were not confirmed from a live source during this research; see pnwathletics.com for current facility information.
program_reputation: NCAA Division II women's softball program competing in the Great Lakes Intercollegiate Athletic Conference (GLIAC). Currently operating under an interim head coach (2026 season).
notes: Staff directory (pnwathletics.com/sports/softball/coaches) fetched live 2026-07-30. Three softball staff members listed: interim head coach and two assistant coaches. No Twitter/X handles were published on the staff page. Roster page confirmed 22 players for 2026. Tuition and scholarship counts left null because they could not be confirmed from a live authoritative source (PNW bursar pages returned 404 during research).
